item.text: {"question_id":"6B.9","answer":"During the 2023 period, Egypt had a layered institutional framework with formal mandates and some reported implementation capacity, but the supplied evidence does not establish the full durability standard. Takaful and Karama operated through a dynamic registry and 15,000 social and community workers, while Universal Health Insurance had enrolled more than 5 million people in six Phase 1 governorates and had more than 322 accredited providers; these figures show operational scale, but not independently verified staffing quality, executed funding reliability, or resilience beyond personal rule (BATCH-0020-E014; BATCH-0023-E003). Anti-trafficking bodies maintained specialized prosecution offices and judicial circuits and trained officials, and Egypt reported additional training through June 2023; however, training is an input rather than proof of professional performance, and victim identification and services remained inconsistent or insufficient (BATCH-0008-E007; BATCH-0023-E015). Formal arrangements for the National Council for Childhood and Motherhood, including legal personality, an independent budget, policy, monitoring, evaluation, complaint, and directive functions, were reported in the pre-2023 framework, but the October 2023 council measure was only parliamentary approval of a draft law and does not establish enactment or operation during the period (BATCH-0024-R01-E014; BATCH-0015-E007). The National Council for Women and the National Council for Persons with Disabilities likewise had reported legal, financial, administrative, or technical independence and defined monitoring or coordination roles, but the supplied records do not independently verify their 2023 reach, resources, staffing, or outcomes (BATCH-0024-R01-E015; BATCH-0024-R04-E006). Against this partial institutional layering, external assessments identified weak implementation mechanisms, inadequate institutional capacity, insufficient funding, poor coordination, and limited civil-society participation; the UN Human Rights Committee also raised concerns about safeguards for the independence and effectiveness of the National Council for Human Rights. Military-managed civilian projects operated with substantial autonomy and extensive information and financial-disclosure exemptions, limiting transparent standards, independent verification, and accountability (BATCH-0009-R10-E003; BATCH-0011-E010; BATCH-0009-R10-E001; BATCH-0009-R10-E004). The evidence therefore supports formal institutional development and some operational continuity during the period, but not demonstrated reliable funding, independent professional administration, transparent standards, or resilience beyond personal rule.","supporting_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0020-E014","BATCH-0023-E003","BATCH-0008-E007","BATCH-0023-E015","BATCH-0024-R01-E014","BATCH-0024-R01-E015","BATCH-0024-R04-E006"],"contrary_or_qualifying_evidence_ids":["BATCH-0015-E007","BATCH-0009-R10-E003","BATCH-0011-E010","BATCH-0009-R10-E001","BATCH-0009-R10-E004"],"limitations_and_gaps":["The period is limited to 2023; post-rule resilience cannot be observed because Sisi remained in office.","Several favorable institutional claims are pre-2023, government-reported, donor-supported, or cumulative rather than 2023-specific.","The supplied evidence does not establish executed budgets, actual staffing quality, independent oversight, service quality, transparent standards, or institutional survival beyond personal rule.","The corrected Carnegie record supports issuance of strategies and cited shortcomings but does not independently prove that every cited deficiency persisted throughout 2023.","Attribution is generally to Egyptian state institutions or the administration; personal initiation by Sisi is not established for most councils or programs."] ,"corrections_made":["Removed unsupported inferences that registry scale, accreditation, or training proved professional staffing, reliable funding, independence, or resilience.","Separated pre-2023 statutory or reported mandates from 2023 implementation evidence.","Characterized the childhood and motherhood council as a draft-law measure rather than an operating institution.","Added the material contrary evidence on insufficient funding, weak capacity, poor coordination, limited participation, disclosure exemptions, and oversight independence.","Preserved the distinction between formal institutional design, operational continuity, and unproven durability beyond personal rule."],"reasons_to_reopen_full_ledger":["No supplied evidence demonstrates post-rule institutional survival or transferability of authority.","Executed financial records, staffing qualifications, independent audits, transparent standards, and outcome or remedy data remain insufficient.","A full ledger review could clarify which institutions were legally enacted and operational specifically during 2023 and how much attribution belongs to Sisi personally versus ministries, parliament, donors, or international partners."]}
